title: Star 3D
preinstall_message: This app contains no game data. You need your own legally dumped disc image of the game (PAL, game ID GSAP01, revision 1): it is converted into a data file that the game loads from sdmc:/3ds/star3d/gamedata/romfs.bin. See the project README for how.
long_description:
# Star 3D

An unofficial port of a 2002 GameCube adventure game to the New Nintendo 3DS / New 2DS XL, built on the foxhollow native PC port and the SFA-Decomp decompilation. The game code is compiled as-is for the 3DS; a 3DS platform layer, the Stellaris engine, replaces the PC graphics, audio, input, disc and save code.

- GameCube GX graphics rebuilt on the PICA200 GPU (citro3d): TEV combiners, fog, lighting, EFB copies, depth of field, fur and grass, water and heat warps
- Stereo 3D that follows the 3D slider, with auto-convergence
- 16:9 widescreen and a minimap HUD on the bottom screen
- The game's music and sound effects on the 3DS DSP
- C-stick camera, gyro aiming, item menu on the touch screen
- Saves on the SD card, with GameCube memory-card semantics

**No game data is included.** You need your own legally dumped disc image of the game (PAL release, game ID GSAP01, revision 1). Its files are extracted and converted into a game data file that the game loads from the SD card (sdmc:/3ds/star3d/gamedata/romfs.bin), so the installable .cia and the .3dsx stay small: the data is put on the SD card once, and later releases are small images installed over the old ones. See the project README for instructions.

Requires a New 3DS / New 2DS XL.
